segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about sports and outdoor activities.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是体育和户外活动。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We are taking a look at a lot of different adventure sports.
segments.zh: 我们正在看很多不同的冒险运动。

segments.en: So they're not just regular sports like tennis or soccer.
segments.zh: 所以它们不仅仅是网球或足球等常规运动。

segments.en: These are more dangerous sports.
segments.zh: 这些是更危险的运动。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So adventure sports is the topic.
segments.zh: 所以冒险运动是话题。

segments.en: This is intermediate level.
segments.zh: 这是中级水平。

segments.en: Let's check out the dialogue and we'll be back in a moment.
segments.zh: 让我们看看对话，我们稍后会回来。

segments.en: Welcome to Adventure Tours.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到探险旅行社。

segments.en: How may I help you?
segments.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: I want to book a tour with Adventure Sports.
segments.zh: 我想预订一个有冒险运动项目的旅行。

segments.en: Excellent.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Our company has more than 10 years of experience in the adventure tourism and sports field.
segments.zh: 我公司在探险旅游运动领域拥有十多年的经验。

segments.en: Let me show you some options.
segments.zh: 让我向您展示一些选项。

segments.en: This is our most popular choice.
segments.zh: 这是我们最受欢迎的选择。

segments.en: Our river guides will take you on a white water rafting trip followed by a ride in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 我们的漂流向导会带您去激流漂流，然后再乘坐热气球。

segments.en: I don't really think I'm ready to throw myself down a river full of jagged rocks in a rubber boat or go up in the air in a wicker basket held up by an oversized balloon.
segments.zh: 我可没准备好坐着橡皮艇冲进满是尖石的河流，也不想待在一个靠巨型气球吊着的柳条篮子里飞上天。

segments.en: What else do you have?
segments.zh: 你还有什么？

segments.en: Well, in that case, we can take you hang gliding with one of our experienced instructors.
segments.zh: 那样的话，可以由我们经验丰富的教练带您体验悬挂式滑翔。

segments.en: It's the closest you can get to flying.
segments.zh: 这是你最接近飞行的地方。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You mean strap myself to a flimsy kite?
segments.zh: 你的意思是把自己绑在一个脆弱的风筝上？

segments.en: No thank you.
segments.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

segments.en: Next.
segments.zh: 接下来。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, why don't you tell me a little bit more about what you would like?
segments.zh: 好吧，你为什么不告诉我更多关于你想要什么？

segments.en: We have everything from mountain biking to rock climbing to street luge.
segments.zh: 我们什么项目都有，从山地自行车、攀岩，到街道无舵雪橇。

segments.en: I'm thinking something exciting but safer.
segments.zh: 我在想一些令人兴奋但更安全的东西。

segments.en: I have the perfect option.
segments.zh: 我有完美的选择。

segments.en: This package will take you on a hiking trip through the Himalayas for three days and afterwards there's a dog sledding journey.
segments.zh: 这个套餐将带您在喜马拉雅山进行三天的徒步旅行，然后进行狗拉雪橇之旅。

segments.en: That's more like it.
segments.zh: 这才像话嘛。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So obviously this tour agency or tour operator has a lot of different options.
segments.zh: 显然，这个旅行社或旅行社有很多不同的选择。

segments.en: A lot of them exciting so why don't we take a look at some of those on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 其中很多令人兴奋，所以我们为什么不看看一些关于语言外卖的东西。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So the first one has to do with water.
segments.zh: 所以第一个与水有关。

segments.en: This is called white water rafting.
segments.zh: 这被称为白水漂流。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So white water rafting.
segments.zh: 所以白水漂流。

segments.en: Now rafting means that you go in a raft.
segments.zh: 现在漂流意味着你进入木筏。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a special kind of boat, not a wooden boat, not like a big boat you see in the ocean.
segments.zh: 这是一种特殊的船，不是木船，不像你在海洋中看到的大船。

segments.en: This is a special boat for rivers maybe.
segments.zh: 这可能是河流的特殊船。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's an inflatable rubber boat.
segments.zh: 这是一艘充气橡胶船。

segments.en: So he also described it as a rubber boat.
segments.zh: 所以他也把它描述为一艘橡皮艇。

segments.en: Okay, rubber is the material it's made out of.
segments.zh: 好的，橡胶是它的材料。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you go in this boat in a river and it's called white water because it has rapids.
segments.zh: 所以你在河里坐这艘船，它被称为白水，因为它有急流。

segments.en: So the river is moving very quickly and you can see that it's a little bit dangerous to go swimming in a river like this.
segments.zh: 所以这条河流非常快，你可以看到在这样的河流中游泳有点危险。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the water goes really fast or when it hits some rocks, the color changes from being blue or brown to white and that's why it's white water rafting.
segments.zh: 所以水真的很快，或者当它撞到一些岩石时，颜色从蓝色或棕色变为白色，这就是为什么它是白水漂流。

segments.en: It's very, very scary and very dangerous.
segments.zh: 它非常非常可怕，非常危险。

segments.en: That's right, but very exciting.
segments.zh: 没错，但非常令人兴奋。

segments.en: So that's considered an adventure sport.
segments.zh: 所以这被认为是一项冒险运动。

segments.en: And then the trip was followed by a ride in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 然后这次旅行乘坐热气球。

segments.en: Well everyone's seen balloons before.
segments.zh: 好吧，每个人以前都看过气球。

segments.en: Sometimes we give children balloons at the fair or maybe for their birthday.
segments.zh: 有时我们会在集市上给孩子们送气球，或者在他们生日时给孩子们送气球。

segments.en: Balloons are basically rubber filled with air.
segments.zh: 气球基本上是充满空气的橡胶。

segments.en: But a hot air balloon is a very special kind of mode of transportation actually.
segments.zh: 但热气球实际上是一种非常特殊的运输方式。

segments.en: You can travel in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 您可以乘坐热气球旅行。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a big, big balloon that has a basket under it and the person actually described it as a wicker basket.
segments.zh: 这是一个大而大的气球，下面有一个篮子，这个人实际上将它描述为一个柳条篮子。

segments.en: A wicker is the material that's used in the basket, right?
segments.zh: 柳条是篮子里使用的材料，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's not furniture like wicker chairs.
segments.zh: 它不像柳条椅那样的家具。

segments.en: It's just a way to basically make furniture out of this kind of bark or natural material.
segments.zh: 这只是一种基本上用这种树皮或天然材料制作家具的方式。

segments.en: So a hot air balloon is a very big balloon and it's filled with hot air, usually by some sort of fire that's under it.
segments.zh: 所以一个热气球是一个非常大的气球，它充满了热空气，通常是在它下面的某种火灾中。

segments.en: And because it's filled with hot air, it goes up in the air and as you say, you can use it as transportation, maybe to go very long distances carried by the wind because there's no real way of giving a direction or just for fun.
segments.zh: 因为它充满了热空气，所以它在空中升起，正如你所说，你可以把它用作交通工具，也许是为了很长的距离，因为没有真正的方式来给出方向或只是为了好玩。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's another dangerous but less dangerous kind of sport.
segments.zh: 这是另一种危险但不那么危险的运动。

segments.en: But after that, we actually have one that I think you have some experience with.
segments.zh: 但在那之后，我们实际上有一种，我认为你有一些经验。

segments.en: It's called hang gliding.
segments.zh: 它被称为悬挂式滑行。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Hang gliding is another type of sport and also a type of flying sport and basically you get on a hang glider.
segments.zh: 悬挂式滑翔是另一种运动，也是一种飞行运动，基本上你可以使用悬挂式滑翔机。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if you've seen this before, you'll know that it looks like someone is wearing wings.
segments.zh: 所以如果你以前见过这个，你就会知道它看起来像是有人戴着翅膀。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a big kite that you wear.
segments.zh: 这是你穿的大风筝。

segments.en: It's a big kite.
segments.zh: 这是一个大风筝。

segments.en: It kind of looks like a triangle, like a kite.
segments.zh: 它看起来像一个三角形，就像风筝一样。

segments.en: And you fly in it.
segments.zh: 你飞进去。

segments.en: So it has no motor.
segments.zh: 所以它没有电机。

segments.en: It has not like the hot air balloon, it has no fire.
segments.zh: 它不像热气球，它没有火。

segments.en: So you just basically glide.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上只是滑行。

segments.en: You just sail through the air, the atmosphere.
segments.zh: 你只是在空气中航行，大气。

segments.en: Sounds very peaceful.
segments.zh: 听起来很平静。

segments.en: It is.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: But they say that you should go with an instructor.
segments.zh: 但他们说你应该和教练一起去。

segments.en: So what kind of instructor does this tour company offer?
segments.zh: 那么这个旅游公司提供什么样的教练呢？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So our operator talked about taking you on a hang glider trip with one of our experienced instructors.
segments.zh: 因此，我们的运营商谈到了带您与我们经验丰富的教练一起进行悬挂式滑翔机之旅。

segments.en: So experienced is the key word here.
segments.zh: 所以经验丰富的是这里的关键词。

segments.en: You want someone who has done this many times before, someone who knows what they are doing.
segments.zh: 你想要一个以前做过很多次的人，一个知道他们在做什么的人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So an experienced instructor is a person that has, as you say, a lot of experience or is a professional.
segments.zh: 因此，有经验的教练是一个拥有丰富经验或专业人士的人。

segments.en: So that's an experienced instructor.
segments.zh: 所以这是一位经验丰富的教练。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You could even say, you know, I want to take flying lessons with an experienced pilot.
segments.zh: 你甚至可以说，你知道，我想和一位经验丰富的飞行员一起上飞行课。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or you can even talk about maybe a chef.
segments.zh: 或者你甚至可以谈论也许是厨师。

segments.en: He is a very experienced chef.
segments.zh: 他是一位非常有经验的厨师。

segments.en: He's been a chef for a long time.
segments.zh: 他做厨师很久了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So hang gliding.
segments.zh: 所以悬挂滑翔。

segments.en: And our final sport, very exciting as well.
segments.zh: 还有我们最后的运动，也非常令人兴奋。

segments.en: We are going dog sledding.
segments.zh: 我们要去狗拉雪橇。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is basically a winter sport or a sport that you do in snowy places.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是你在白雪皑皑的地方进行的冬季运动或运动。

segments.en: You stand or sit on a sled and a team of dogs, so that means many dogs, pull you across the snow.
segments.zh: 你站在或坐在雪橇和一群狗上，这意味着许多狗，把你拉到雪地上。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you go on a sled, which is basically usually made out of plastic or wood, and this is to go on top of the snow.
segments.zh: 所以你去一个雪橇，它基本上是用塑料或木头制成的，这是在雪的顶部。

segments.en: And as you say, a team of dogs pull you.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，一群狗拉着你。

segments.en: I think you can see this in movies.
segments.zh: 我想你可以在电影中看到这一点。

segments.en: This is kind of like the mode of transportation in places where there are no roads, there are no other ways of getting places that you just get pulled by dogs.
segments.zh: 这有点像在没有道路的地方的交通方式，没有其他方法可以让你被狗拉着的地方。

segments.en: Like Alaska or the Arctic Circle, somewhere very, very far north.
segments.zh: 像阿拉斯加或北极圈，非常非常北的某个地方。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a lot of great adventure sports.
segments.zh: 所以很多伟大的冒险运动。

segments.en: Very exciting.
segments.zh: 非常令人兴奋。

segments.en: I think it's time for us to listen to the dialogue again.
segments.zh: 我认为是时候让我们再次聆听对话了。

segments.en: And we'll be back in a bit with Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 我们将在第 2 部分中回归语言外卖。

segments.en: How may I help you?
segments.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: I want to book a tour with Adventure Sports.

segments.en: Our company has more than 10 years of experience in the adventure, tourism, and sports field.

segments.en: Let me show you some options.

segments.en: This is our most popular choice.
segments.zh: 这是我们最受欢迎的选择。

segments.en: Our river guides will take you on a whitewater rafting trip followed by a ride in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 我们的河流导游将带您进行激流漂流之旅，然后乘坐热气球。

segments.en: I don't really think I'm ready to throw myself down a river full of jagged rocks in a rubber boat or go up in the air in a wicker basket held up by an oversized balloon.
segments.zh: 我可没准备好坐着橡皮艇冲进满是尖石的河流，也不想待在一个靠巨型气球吊着的柳条篮子里飞上天。

segments.en: What else do you have?
segments.zh: 你还有什么？

segments.en: Well, in that case, we can take you hang gliding with one of our experienced instructors.
segments.zh: 那样的话，可以由我们经验丰富的教练带您体验悬挂式滑翔。

segments.en: It's the closest you can get to flying.
segments.zh: 这是你最接近飞行的地方。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You mean strap myself to a flimsy kite?
segments.zh: 你的意思是把自己绑在一个脆弱的风筝上？

segments.en: No thank you.
segments.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

segments.en: Next?
segments.zh: 接下来？

segments.en: Mm, OK.
segments.zh: 嗯，好的。

segments.en: Well, why don't you tell me a little bit more about what you would like?
segments.zh: 好吧，你为什么不告诉我更多关于你想要什么？

segments.en: We have everything from mountain biking to rock climbing to street luge.
segments.zh: 我们什么项目都有，从山地自行车、攀岩，到街道无舵雪橇。

segments.en: I'm thinking something exciting but safer.
segments.zh: 我在想一些令人兴奋但更安全的东西。

segments.en: I have the perfect option.
segments.zh: 我有完美的选择。

segments.en: This package will take you on a hiking trip through the Himalayas for three days and afterwards there's a dog sledding journey.
segments.zh: 这个套餐将带您在喜马拉雅山进行三天的徒步旅行，然后进行狗拉雪橇之旅。

segments.en: That's more like it.
segments.zh: 这才像话嘛。

segments.en: So now we're going to take a look at three quick adjectives that we saw in this dialogue on Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们要看一下我们在关于语言外卖第 2 部分的对话中看到的三个快速形容词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: This first adjective is something I'm not a fan of.
segments.zh: 第一个形容词是我不喜欢的东西。

segments.en: Let me just say if you ever go rafting and you see rocks, you want to avoid or you want to stay away from jagged rocks.
segments.zh: 让我说，如果你去漂流，你看到岩石，你想避开，或者你想远离锯齿状的岩石。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the adjective jagged refers to maybe sharp or they can cut you, right?
segments.zh: 所以形容词锯齿可能是指尖锐的，或者他们可以割伤你，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So something that is jagged is not smooth.
segments.zh: 所以锯齿状的东西并不顺利。

segments.en: It's the opposite of smooth.
segments.zh: 这是平滑的反面。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe you've seen some rocks that are very pointy or that have things that can easily hurt you or cut you.
segments.zh: 所以也许你见过一些非常尖的岩石，或者有一些东西很容易伤害你或割伤你。

segments.en: Those are jagged rocks.
segments.zh: 那些是锯齿状的岩石。

segments.en: Broken glass can have jagged edges and that means you want to avoid touching it because it can hurt you.
segments.zh: 破碎的玻璃可能有锯齿状的边缘，这意味着您要避免触摸它，因为它会伤害您。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So jagged is a way of describing something that's maybe sharp, pointy or very dangerous that can cut you.
segments.zh: 所以锯齿是一种描述可能尖锐、尖尖或非常危险的东西的方式，可以割伤你。

segments.en: And then moving on, when we were talking about the hot air balloon, this person very cleverly said that he doesn't want to go up in the air in a basket held by an oversized balloon.
segments.zh: 然后继续前进，当我们谈论热气球时，这个人非常巧妙地说他不想在一个超大气球拿着的篮子里飞起来。

segments.en: Okay, so he's exaggerating.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以他在夸大其词。

segments.en: Like you said, he's being clever or silly.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，他是聪明或愚蠢的。

segments.en: He's just afraid of the balloon.
segments.zh: 他只是害怕气球。

segments.en: But basically he's saying an oversized balloon is a very, very, very big or unnaturally big balloon.
segments.zh: 但基本上他是说一个超大的气球是一个非常、非常、非常大或不自然的大气球。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So bigger than normal.
segments.zh: 所以比平时大。

segments.en: So an oversized balloon would be a balloon that's bigger than normal.
segments.zh: 所以一个超大的气球将是一个比正常大的气球。

segments.en: Or maybe I've seen an oversized...
segments.zh: 或许我见过超大号...

segments.en: In the early 1990s, I remember a clothing trend, a lot of people like to wear oversized t-shirts.
segments.zh: 在1990年代初期，我记得一种服装趋势，很多人都喜欢穿超大号的T恤。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So t-shirts that were way too big for you or maybe unnaturally big, those would be oversized t-shirts.
segments.zh: 所以对你来说太大的 T 恤，或者可能不自然地大，那些会是超大的 T 恤。

segments.en: Like XXXL.
segments.zh: 像xxxl。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And our final adjective when he was talking about hang gliding, he said that he's not ready to go up in the air strapped to a flimsy kite.
segments.zh: 而我们最后的形容词当他谈到悬挂式滑翔时，他说他还没有准备好在空中被绑在一个脆弱的风筝上。

segments.en: Okay, so the key word here is flimsy.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里的关键词是脆弱的。

segments.en: We already talked about a kite.
segments.zh: 我们已经谈到了风筝。

segments.en: It's something that flies in the air.
segments.zh: 它是在空中飞翔的东西。

segments.en: But something that's flimsy is not very stable or sturdy.
segments.zh: 但脆弱的东西不是很稳定或坚固。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it doesn't seem like it's very solid.
segments.zh: 所以看起来不是很坚固。

segments.en: So if you have a kite...
segments.zh: 所以如果你有风筝...

segments.en: So a normal airplane is very sturdy, but a paper airplane is very flimsy.
segments.zh: 所以普通飞机非常坚固，但纸飞机非常脆弱。

segments.en: It's thin, it moves around a lot.
segments.zh: 它很薄，它移动了很多。

segments.en: You can't control it.
segments.zh: 你控制不了它。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So it's not very solid.
segments.zh: 所以它不是很坚固。

segments.en: It's not very, as you said, sturdy.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这不是很坚固。

segments.en: It doesn't really seem like it can stay up in the air for very long.
segments.zh: 它似乎真的不能在空中停留很长时间。

segments.en: And it definitely can't support someone's weight.
segments.zh: 它绝对不能支持某人的体重。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you can even have a flimsy chair.
segments.zh: 所以你甚至可以拥有一把脆弱的椅子。

segments.en: Maybe the chair is a little bit loose or it doesn't seem like it's very strong.
segments.zh: 也许椅子有点松，或者看起来不是很结实。

segments.en: It feels like it might break.
segments.zh: 感觉可能会破裂。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So flimsy.
segments.zh: 太脆弱了。

segments.en: That's the adjective there, flimsy.
segments.zh: 那是形容词，脆弱。

segments.en: So that's all the adjectives we have for you today.
segments.zh: 这就是我们今天为您提供的所有形容词。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue quickly one last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 为什么我们不上次快速听对话，我们会回来多说一点。

segments.en: Welcome to Adventure Tours.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到探险旅行社。

segments.en: How may I help you?
segments.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: I want to book a tour with Adventure Sports.
segments.zh: 我想预订一个有冒险运动项目的旅行。

segments.en: Excellent!
segments.zh: 优秀!

segments.en: Our company has more than 10 years of experience in the adventure, tourism, and sports field.
segments.zh: 我公司在探险、旅游、运动领域拥有十多年的经验。

segments.en: Let me show you some options.
segments.zh: 让我向您展示一些选项。

segments.en: This is our most popular choice.
segments.zh: 这是我们最受欢迎的选择。

segments.en: Our river guides will take you on a white water rafting trip followed by a ride in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 我们的漂流向导会带您去激流漂流，然后再乘坐热气球。

segments.en: I don't really think I'm ready to throw myself down a river full of jagged rocks in a rubber boat or go up in the air in a wicker basket held up by an oversized balloon.
segments.zh: 我可没准备好坐着橡皮艇冲进满是尖石的河流，也不想待在一个靠巨型气球吊着的柳条篮子里飞上天。

segments.en: What else do you have?
segments.zh: 你还有什么？

segments.en: Well, in that case, we can take you hang gliding with one of our experienced instructors.
segments.zh: 那样的话，可以由我们经验丰富的教练带您体验悬挂式滑翔。

segments.en: It's the closest you can get to flying.
segments.zh: 这是你最接近飞行的地方。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You mean strap myself to a flimsy kite?
segments.zh: 你的意思是把自己绑在一个脆弱的风筝上？

segments.en: No thank you.
segments.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

segments.en: Next?
segments.zh: 接下来？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, why don't you tell me a little bit more about what you would like?
segments.zh: 好吧，你为什么不告诉我更多关于你想要什么？

segments.en: We have everything from mountain biking to rock climbing to street luge.
segments.zh: 我们什么项目都有，从山地自行车、攀岩，到街道无舵雪橇。

segments.en: I'm thinking something exciting but safer.
segments.zh: 我在想一些令人兴奋但更安全的东西。

segments.en: I have the perfect option.
segments.zh: 我有完美的选择。

segments.en: This package will take you on a hiking trip through the Himalayas for three days and afterwards there's a dog sledding journey.
segments.zh: 这个套餐将带您在喜马拉雅山进行三天的徒步旅行，然后进行狗拉雪橇之旅。

segments.en: That's more like it.
segments.zh: 这才像话嘛。

segments.en: Okay so Marco, I know this is one of your favorite areas, Adventure Sports.
segments.zh: 好的，马可，我知道这是你最喜欢的领域之一，冒险运动。

segments.en: You're a lot more daring than I am because I wouldn't do many of these things but what have you done?
segments.zh: 你比我大胆得多，因为我不会做很多这些事情，但你做了什么？

segments.en: I've actually haven't been in a hot air balloon.
segments.zh: 其实我还没坐过热气球。

segments.en: I don't really think that's very exciting.
segments.zh: 我真的不认为这很令人兴奋。

segments.en: It does seem kind of boring.
segments.zh: 这看起来有点无聊。

segments.en: Yeah, you don't really go very fast.
segments.zh: 是的，你真的走得不是很快。

segments.en: And I've never done a street luge which is an interesting sport although it is pretty dangerous.
segments.zh: 我从来没有做过街头雪橇，这是一项有趣的运动，尽管它很危险。

segments.en: It's basically, you're kind of riding on a type of skateboard, right?
segments.zh: 基本上，你有点骑在一种滑板上，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, basically it's a big skateboard and you lie down on it, your feet go down and your head is back.
segments.zh: 是的，基本上它是一个大滑板，你躺在上面，你的脚向下，你的头向后。

segments.en: You're on your back and you go downhill really fast.
segments.zh: 你在你的背上，你真的很快就走下坡路。

segments.en: This is actually an Olympic sport and it's simply called luge and you can see this with those big icy tracks that they have and they go downhill and they slide down on a bob sled or luge would actually be the same thing but just one or two people on some type of like skateboard looking thing.
segments.zh: 这实际上是一项奥林匹克运动，它被简单地称为雪橇，你可以看到他们拥有的那些冰冷的大赛道，它们走下坡路，它们在鲍勃雪橇或雪橇上滑下实际上是一样的，但只有一两个人在某种类型的滑板上看起来像滑板。

segments.en: Basically it's open.
segments.zh: 基本上它是开放的。

segments.en: The bob sled is closed so you see the people's heads but the luge you just see their whole body and they're lying down on a piece of metal and they go down very, very quickly.
segments.zh: 鲍勃雪橇是关闭的，所以你看到人们的头，但你看到他们的整个身体，他们躺在一块金属上，他们很快就倒下了。

segments.en: They go very fast.
segments.zh: 他们走得非常快。

segments.en: I think in bob sledding and luge, I think they can reach speeds up to like 100 kilometers per hour or more.
segments.zh: 我认为在 Bob Sledding 和 Luge 中，我认为它们的速度可以达到每小时 100 公里或更多。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And this year it was actually very sad at the Olympics.
segments.zh: 今年的奥运会真的很伤心。

segments.en: A luge, I think it was luge athlete died in practice.
segments.zh: 一辆雪橇，我想是雪橇运动员在训练中死去的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So extreme sports or adventure sports, they are as the name says full of adventure, very exciting but also obviously very dangerous.
segments.zh: 所以极限运动或冒险运动，它们就像名字所说的充满冒险，非常令人兴奋，但显然也非常危险。

segments.en: I think hiking is not really an adventure sport or very dangerous unless you're hiking in dangerous territory with bears or something.
segments.zh: 我认为徒步旅行并不是真正的冒险运动或非常危险的运动，除非你在危险的地区与熊或其他东西一起徒步旅行。

segments.en: Possible.
segments.zh: 可能。

segments.en: Well, maybe you guys should let us know what kind of sports do you do.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许你们应该让我们知道你从事什么样的运动。

segments.en: Do you enjoy adventure sports?
segments.zh: 你喜欢冒险运动吗？

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see everyone there.
segments.zh: 到时候见，各位。

segments.en: Bye. Thank you.
segments.zh: 再见。 谢谢。
